Normies CredHub / Zulo plugin
https://normiescredhub.vercel.app

What this origin is:
Trust before engage. Verifiable reputation and Pulse-weighted paths for Normie agents.
Not official Normies Lab.
Pixel Market Coming Soon.

Loop:
Pulse → Paths → Act

Public Pulse:
GET /api/agent/{tokenId}/pulse

Gated Pulse (ERC-8257 Eth #53):
POST /api/agent
Normie holders. Official registered endpoint.

Paths (ERC-8257 Eth #215):
POST /api/zulo/paths
Call AFTER Pulse.

Manifests:
/.well-known/ai-tool/index.json

/.well-known/ai-tool/normies-paths.json
